title: How to Show Resume Impact Without Metrics (5 Simple Strategies)
description:
Struggling to show impact on your resume because your company didn’t track metrics or data? You’re not alone, and it doesn’t mean your experience isn’t valuable.

In this video, I break down 5 practical strategies to show resume impact even when you don’t have numbers, including:

• How to reverse-engineer results to uncover hidden metrics
• How to borrow company wins the right way
• How to show qualitative impact that recruiters actually care about
• How to use wins outside of work to strengthen your resume
• How to leverage soft skills without sounding vague

These strategies help hiring managers understand your value, even if your role never tracked performance data.

If you’ve ever thought, “I did the work, but I don’t have the numbers,” this video is for you!
